## Summary

The site pivoted from an email-cleanup product ("InboxZap") to an AI meeting assistant ("Lumina"), but the marketing site's source never fully caught up — I found and fixed five concrete problems, backed by the GSC export and a live-site diff:

**Fixed:**
1. **`app/layout.tsx`** — the site-wide `<title>`/meta description still said *"InboxZap — Clean Your Inbox in Minutes"*. GSC shows "inboxzap"/"inboxzap app"/"inboxzap review" queries pulling ~18 clicks at position 4–9 — almost exactly the homepage's entire click total — meaning brand-loyal searchers were clicking through on that old promise and landing on an unrelated product. Replaced with accurate Lumina title/description/OG/Twitter tags, added `metadataBase`, and added Organization JSON-LD.
2. **`app/blog/page.tsx`** was pure client-fetch to `/api/posts`, a route that doesn't exist — the index never rendered a single real link, orphaning every post for users and crawlers alike. Rewrote it as a server component with real `<a>` links rendered in the initial HTML.
3. **`app/sitemap.ts`** explicitly stubbed out blog posts ("TODO... once the content API exposes a stable listing"), despite posts carrying the site's largest impression counts (600–3,900 each). Now generates real entries from the post data, plus the new bridge page.
4. **Dead FAQ redirect**: nav/footer linked to `/faq`, which 301s to `/#faq`, but no `#faq` section existed. Added a real FAQ section with FAQPage JSON-LD to the homepage.
5. **Off-topic content cluster**: all 12 indexed blog posts were about email cleanup/inbox zero — zero relevance to meeting-assistant buyers, which is why they already convert at ~0% despite real impressions. Retired them with 301s to `/blog` (not a blanket homepage redirect, which risks looking like a soft-404 pattern) and replaced with 5 new posts targeting topics an AI meeting assistant's actual audience searches for (meeting summaries, action-item follow-through, AI note accuracy, async standups, Zoom/Meet/Teams transcription comparison), each with per-post metadata, canonical URLs, and BlogPosting JSON-LD.
6. Added `/from-inboxzap` — a short bridge page so legacy branded search traffic gets oriented instead of silently landing on an unrelated hero, linked from the footer.

Verified with a clean `next build` (no errors/warnings) and a smoke test of the running prod server: homepage FAQ/schema render correctly, blog posts statically generate and serve correct metadata, `/blog/post-3` 301s to `/blog`, and the sitemap now lists all 10 real URLs.

**Not changed, flagged for follow-up:** `/img/og-lumina.png` doesn't exist as an actual asset yet (same gap existed before, just under the old filename) — needs to be exported and added to `public/img/`. `next@14.2.5` has a known security advisory; worth upgrading separately from this SEO pass.
